content.title: About
content.content: The dish consists of lean beef, boiled rice and vegetables such as carrots, broccoli and dark‑green leafy greens. It is prepared with a soy‑based sauce, giving it a savory, slightly sweet flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Beef is a high‑quality source of complete protein containing all essential amino acids.
Rice provides complex carbohydrates that supply long‑lasting energy.
Broccoli is rich in vitamin C and compounds that support the body’s detoxification processes.
Dark‑green leafy vegetables (spinach, kale) are packed with iron and folate.
Traditional soy sauce is fermented from soybeans, making it rich in proteins and minerals.

items.title: Supports muscle mass
items.content: Beef supplies high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Provides energy
items.content: Rice delivers glucose that the body readily converts into energy.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Broccoli and leafy greens contain vitamin C, beta‑carotene and polyphenols that protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Beef and leafy greens provide calcium, magnesium and vitamin K, important for strong bones.

items.title: Improves digestion
items.content: Fiber from the vegetables and rice supports healthy bowel function.

items.title: Saturated fat content
items.content: Consuming large amounts of fatty cuts of beef may raise cholesterol levels.

items.title: Sodium levels
items.content: Soy sauce is high in salt; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to soy sauce.

items.title: Pesticide residues
items.content: Choose organic vegetables or wash them thoroughly to reduce pesticide exposure.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish hot, combining sautéed beef strips with steamed rice and vegetables, drizzled with soy sauce. Add fresh ginger or garlic for extra flavor if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared dish in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat to at least 75 °C. It can be frozen for up to 2 months, preferably portioned out beforehand.

content.title: About
content.content: Chicken roll is a roasted piece of chicken breast rolled into a cylindrical shape and seasoned with spices. It has a tender flavor, aromatic spices, and a crisp outer crust.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Roasting retains most of the nutrients found in chicken meat.
Rolls are commonly used in fast‑food and as a convenient snack.
For a golden crust, rolls are often brushed with a light coating of breadcrumbs or flour.
Chicken is considered a leaner protein compared with beef or pork.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Chicken provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: When roasted, the roll contains less fat than fried alternatives, making it suitable for weight‑controlled diets.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Chicken is a good source of vitamin B6 and niacin, which support metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The roll supplies phosphorus, selenium and zinc, important for bones and immune function.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken.

items.title: Bacterial contamination
items.content: Undercooked meat can harbor salmonella; proper cooking temperatures are essential.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Added salt and sauces can raise sodium levels, which may be a concern for hypertension.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Chicken roll can be enjoyed hot or cold, sliced into salads, sandwiches, added to pasta dishes, or served with a yogurt‑based dip.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the roll in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C in an airtight container for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze at –18 °C.

content.title: About
content.content: Lime juice 100% non‑sweetened (NS) is produced from fresh limes by cold pressing. The juice retains the natural aroma, bright acidity, and a rich vitamin profile characteristic of lime.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Lime provides over 30 mg of vitamin C per 100 ml, more than orange juice.
Traditionally used in Mexican, Thai and Vietnamese cuisines to add fresh tanginess.
Lime juice is often used in cosmetics as a skin‑toning rinse because of its antioxidant properties.
Lime is one of the few citrus fruits high in flavonoids such as naringenin.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, collagen synthesis and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids and carotenoids in lime juice help neutralize free radicals.

items.title: Aids digestion
items.content: The acids in lime stimulate gastric juice production, improving food digestion.

items.title: May reduce kidney stone risk
items.content: Citric acid present in the juice can help dissolve small oxalate stones.

items.title: Supports weight control
items.content: Low‑calorie yet flavorful, lime juice can replace higher‑calorie sauces and dressings.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Citrus allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to lime juice.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Lime acids can enhance the effect of certain medications, such as anticoagulants.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Add lime juice to cocktails, marinades, sauces, salads and desserts. For drinks, dilute with water or use as a flavor boost in smoothies.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 0–4 °C in a tightly sealed container. After opening, use within 5–7 days. Discard if the color, smell or taste changes.

content.title: About
content.content: The Nutritional Powder Mix (NFS, item 5493) is a balanced blend of high‑quality proteins, vitamins, minerals and carbohydrates designed to support energy, muscle recovery and overall health. The powder dissolves easily in water, milk or juice and is suitable for athletes as well as active‑lifestyle individuals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend combines whey and plant proteins, providing a complete amino‑acid profile.
It includes adaptogens such as rhodiola extract to help the body cope with stress.
Each serving delivers more than 20 % of the daily reference intake for vitamin D and calcium.
The product is free from gluten, lactose and artificial sweeteners.
Packaging is made from recyclable material, reducing environmental impact.

items.title: Supports muscle growth
items.content: A rich protein complex promotes muscle‑protein synthesis and speeds up post‑workout recovery.

items.title: Boosts energy levels
items.content: A mix of fast‑ and slow‑digesting carbohydrates provides steady energy without sharp blood‑sugar spikes.

items.title: Enhances immune function
items.content: B‑vitamins, vitamin C and zinc support the immune system’s normal activity.

items.title: Promotes bone health
items.content: Calcium, vitamin D and magnesium help maintain bone density.

items.title: Reduces stress
items.content: Adaptogenic ingredients help lessen fatigue and improve adaptation to physical stress.

items.title: Protein allergy
items.content: The product contains whey protein, which may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with dairy‑protein intolerance.

items.title: Excessive protein intake
items.content: Very high consumption can place strain on the kidneys, especially in people with pre‑existing kidney conditions.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although moderate, people with diabetes should account for the carbohydrate amount in their total daily intake.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: High levels of vitamin K may affect the efficacy of anticoagulants; consult a healthcare professional if you take such medication.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one scoop (≈30 g) of powder with 250–300 ml of water, milk or a plant‑based beverage. For a thicker texture, add a banana or oats. Consumption is recommended immediately after training or as a nutritious snack between meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place, tightly sealed. After opening, use within 3 months and keep refrigerated if ambient temperature exceeds 25 °C.
